{"name": "716d8eee-94f3-471f-a35c-8463f676724e", "singleVisual": {"visualType": "textbox", "objects": {"general": [{"properties": {"paragraphs": [{"textRuns": [{"value": "COMPREHENSIVE RESEARCH SYNTHESIS

• Scope & Data: BarrierLens analyzes 724,115 individual responses from NFHS-5 India across 36 States/UTs.
• Multi-Stage Modeling: Stage 1 classifies Household (27.2%), Logistical (31.6%), and Health Facility (46.0%) barriers. Stage 2 links barrier probabilities to Unmet Need for Family Planning (10.6% observed rate, N = 466,859).
• Key Findings: XGBoost & Random Forest achieve a top ROC-AUC of 0.6657. Barrier features add statistically significant predictive uplift beyond socioeconomic factors alone.
